usage: Compact implementation spec. Agent should read status.json first, then only the object for status.currentPhase.

phase-00-baseline.goal: Establish reproducible baseline and validation workflow.
tasks: Add npm script typecheck=tsc --noEmit.
Run npm install if dependencies are missing.
Run baseline commands and record failures in status.json evidence.
Only adjust Jest native mocks if required for future tests to load modules.
phase-00-baseline.gate: Validation workflow is reproducible; known failures are recorded.
doNot: Do not repair App.tsx in this phase.
Do not add LiteRT bridge in this phase.

phase-01-app-shell-settings.goal: Make app entry compile, initialize context path, show settings, and support manual save.
tasks: Replace incomplete App.tsx component.
On mount set ContextManager path to RNFS.DocumentDirectoryPath/topics before reads.
Add Zustand runtime settings: manualCaptureEnabled, pushToRecordEnabled, wakeWordEnabled, liteRtEnabled.
Add typed lifecycle/capture/readiness state.
Render text input, manual save, push-to-record button, settings toggles, context sections.
Manual save trims input, calls addThought, clears input after enqueue.
Disable controls when setting or readiness is false.
phase-01-app-shell-settings.gate: App compiles, settings exist, manual save can enqueue, context path is set before reads.
doNot: Do not implement background wake-word.
Do not persist settings yet.

phase-02-context-store-queue.goal: Guarantee every valid thought is persisted and queue cannot spin forever.
tasks: Add fallback topic Inbox.
Guard empty ContextManager path.
Normalize blank/invalid topics to Inbox.
Match section headers case-insensitively.
Use temp write + move when RNFS supports it, else document direct write fallback.
Add queue attempts and MAX_ATTEMPTS=2.
On repeated failure append raw transcript to Inbox.
Add queue listener/state notifications: pendingCount, isProcessing, currentThoughtId, lastError.
Store subscribes to queue events and reloads context after completed jobs.
Remove store polling intervals.
phase-02-context-store-queue.gate: Thoughts persist on success and failure; no polling intervals; no infinite retry loop.
doNot: Do not drop transcripts on synthesis failure.

phase-03-synthesis-litert.goal: Add runtime-neutral synthesis and make LiteRT the primary target with safe fallback.
tasks: Create SynthesisRuntime, RuntimeReadiness, SynthesizedThought types.
Implement HeuristicSynthesisRuntime from existing heuristic logic.
Implement raw fallback to Inbox.
Implement LiteRtSynthesisRuntime TS wrapper around native module.
Refactor SynthesisService to try LiteRT when enabled, then heuristic, then raw fallback.
Remove direct llama.rn from default synthesis path.
Add iOS LiteRT pod using TensorFlowLiteSwift or TensorFlowLiteObjC.
Add native LiteRtModule methods: isAvailable, loadModel, synthesize, benchmark, release.
Do not commit model binaries; document model path/source/checksum/license.
Create docs/litert-evaluation.md.
phase-03-synthesis-litert.gate: Synthesis is runtime-neutral; missing LiteRT cannot block saving a thought.
doNot: Do not let UI/queue/persistence call LiteRT directly.
Do not commit large model files.

phase-03-settings-navigation-model-manag.goal: Move settings navigation into the breadcrumb, keep home focused on synthesized topics, and add install/delete model management with fresh catalog refreshes.
tasks: Move the settings CTA out of the screen tabs and into the breadcrumb header.
Keep the home screen focused on synthesized topics and the entry composer only.
Keep the welcome screen lean and remove the old settings CTA.
Add install/delete actions for each model in settings, including the active model summary.
Refresh the model catalog from the source list whenever settings opens and before install/delete actions run.
Update the tracker state and tests to match the new navigation and model-management flow.
phase-03-settings-navigation-model-manag.gate: Settings navigation uses the breadcrumb, home is topic-focused, and model install/delete actions reconcile against a fresh catalog.
doNot: Do not reintroduce settings as a tab CTA.
Do not change the blocked LiteRT package work.

phase-04-audio-wakeword.goal: Stabilize push-to-record and implement foreground-only wake-word.
tasks: Make initializeModels return AudioReadiness.
Lazy-request microphone permission on audio action.
Disable record when Whisper missing.
Ensure start/stop recording cannot leave isRecording stuck true.
Empty transcript does not enqueue.
Non-empty transcript calls store addThought.
Foreground wake-word runs only when app active and wakeWordEnabled true.
Stop wake-word listener when app backgrounds.
Prevent duplicate recording if wake-word fires while recording.
Remove or feature-gate BackgroundService from MVP runtime path.
phase-04-audio-wakeword.gate: Push-to-record and foreground wake-word obey readiness/settings and degrade safely.
doNot: Do not claim background or locked-screen wake-word.

phase-05-tests-docs-release.goal: Prove MVP behavior and keep the implementation tracker docs + JSON aligned.
tasks: Add tests for app shell, settings, ContextManager, synthesis fallback, queue retry, audio readiness, wake-word toggle.
Keep the implementation tracker docs and JSON files synchronized.
Document foreground-only wake-word.
Document Android LiteRT/NPU as deferred.
Document LiteRT model setup and evaluation.
phase-05-tests-docs-release.gate: iOS MVP launches; all toggles work; every thought persists; tracker docs and JSON stay aligned.
doNot: Do not claim agent sync, hardware trigger, Android NPU, or background wake-word.

phase-06-note-edit-and-topic-linking.goal: Enable note editing and topic-linking acceleration while preserving source metadata and fallback safety.
phase-06-note-edit-and-topic-linking.smallAgentHint: Start at slice 1. Do not build edit screens until stable note identity/source metadata and ContextManager helpers are done.
tasks: Add edit action for queue items and persisted notes.
Define stable note identity and structured source metadata schema for queued and persisted entries.
Add dedicated edit-note screen and route wiring.
On edit save, requeue note for re-synthesis.
Preserve deep original source metadata and expose metadata view in modal.
Add optional topic selector for linking.
Implement dual synthesis behavior: auto-topic path uses two passes; selected-topic path uses one pass against selected topic content.
Ensure edits never bypass fallback persistence protections.
slices: 1. Define note identity and source metadata types before UI work. Cover queued and persisted notes.
2. Extend ContextManager with read/update/remove helpers for stable persisted note IDs.
3. Extend ProcessingQueueManager and store actions so queue items can be edited, removed, and requeued safely.
4. Add edit route/screen with save/cancel behavior and tests for queue-item edit.
5. Add persisted-note edit entry points from Inbox/thread details and tests for re-synthesis after save.
6. Add metadata modal for source details without cluttering list rows.
7. Add topic selector UI fed by existing context sections.
8. Implement selected-topic one-pass synthesis path, then auto-topic two-pass path.
9. Run focused tests after each slice and update status.json evidence incrementally.
sliceDoneCriteria: Slice 1 done when shared note identity/source metadata types exist, are documented in info.md, and are covered by type-level or unit tests.
Slice 2 done when persisted note read/update/remove behavior works for duplicate text entries and source metadata survives round trips.
Slice 3 done when queued items can be edited/requeued without editing the active processing item unsafely.
Slice 4 done when edit screen can save/cancel queue item edits and route back without losing queue state.
Slice 5 done when Inbox/thread entries expose edit, save creates a re-synthesis job, and original entry handling is tested.
Slice 6 done when source metadata modal works from queue and persisted-note surfaces without cluttering row UI.
Slice 7 done when topic selector is searchable and fed from current context sections.
Slice 8 done when selected-topic path uses one synthesis pass and auto-topic path uses topic-identification plus comprehensive-context pass.
Slice 9 done when status.json evidence includes validation commands and results for all prior slices.
parallelization: Slices 1 and 2 are foundational and should not be parallelized with later slices.
After slice 2, queue edit UI and persisted-note edit UI may be implemented by separate agents if they share the same note metadata contract.
Topic selector UI can proceed after slice 1, but synthesis behavior must wait until slice 8.
Metadata modal can proceed after slice 1 and should consume the shared source metadata contract.
validation: npm test -- --runInBand src/modules/SynthesisEngine src/modules/ContextManager src/features/reflections src/features/threads src/features/queue
phase-06-note-edit-and-topic-linking.gate: Queue and persisted notes are editable, metadata is preserved/viewable, and topic-linking acceleration paths are covered by tests.
doNot: Do not drop source metadata on edit.
Do not regress fallback persistence.

phase-07-voice-error-surface-and-audio-r.goal: Unify voice error visibility across surfaces and add retained-audio fallback when transcription fails.
tasks: Show empty/failure voice indication in composer, queue rows, and thread capture rows.
Re-evaluate recordability on app launch and on record-trigger attempts.
When transcription succeeds, persist transcript only.
When transcription fails, persist audio file with playback support and delete controls.
Keep delete/edit controls available for both text and voice unsynthesized content.
validation: npm test -- --runInBand src/modules/AudioEngine src/features/capture src/features/queue src/features/threads
phase-07-voice-error-surface-and-audio-r.gate: Voice error states are visible on all required surfaces; audio-retention fallback and playback are verified.
doNot: Do not retain redundant audio when transcript succeeded.
Do not leave stalled recording/transcribing states.

phase-08-assistant-intents-shortcuts.goal: Add assistant intents/shortcuts integration for Siri/Google phrase-triggered capture.
tasks: Implement intents/shortcuts ingestion path for assistant-triggered text capture.
Add platform settings guidance UI for binding/setup.
Normalize inbound content and queue through the same persistence-safe flow.
Document supported invocation patterns and platform limits.
phase-08-assistant-intents-shortcuts.gate: Assistant shortcut captures persist safely and settings provide setup guidance.
doNot: Do not claim free-form assistant parsing beyond intents/shortcuts.
Do not bypass queue/persistence invariants.

phase-09-headset-triple-tap-trigger.goal: Add headset button triple-tap trigger for start/stop capture in active scope.
tasks: Implement triple-tap headset button detection and debounce logic.
Map triple-tap to record start/stop transitions.
If readiness fails, provide spoken and visual guidance toward settings.
Ensure trigger path reuses standard capture, transcription, queueing, and fallback logic.
phase-09-headset-triple-tap-trigger.gate: Headset triple-tap reliably starts/stops capture and respects readiness/error behaviors.
doNot: Do not duplicate capture pipelines for trigger-based recording.
Do not regress manual or push-to-record behavior.

phase-10-import-and-permissioned-merge.goal: Ship import screen for text/voice ingestion with searchable topic targeting and user-approved merges.
tasks: Add import screen with pasted text and voice file upload.
Support formats: .m4a, .mp3, .wav, .aac, .ogg, .opus.
Queue imported content for synthesis.
Add searchable optional topic selector for direct append acceleration.
For related-topic merge candidates, request explicit user permission before merge.
Create new topic thread when no related topic exists.
phase-10-import-and-permissioned-merge.gate: Import workflow handles text/voice ingestion, topic selection, and permissioned merge decisions end-to-end.
doNot: Do not silently merge related topics without explicit approval.
Do not drop imported payloads on synthesis failures.

phase-11-roadmap-hardening-and-release-q.goal: Run final hardening, cross-flow regression QA, and release documentation alignment for roadmap features.
tasks: Complete end-to-end QA against app-behaviour roadmap checklist.
Add/repair automated tests for new roadmap flows.
Resolve known lint environment blocker or document enforced workaround.
Align all docs and tracker evidence with verified behavior.
Record physical-device and simulator validation evidence.
phase-11-roadmap-hardening-and-release-q.gate: Roadmap features are validated, documented, and release-ready with evidence.
doNot: Do not mark roadmap complete without device QA evidence.
Do not leave tracker/docs out of sync.
